NEWS ITEM -- The battle-searched here who salutes you in the Above photograph is Jan Kovtnik, a Czecho-Slovak Lad of 13,who has to his credit 4 years in battle, where he fought alongside of the men,2 nicks on his gun for two dead Germans, and a badge of honor for the capture of a cannon. He is hers to be educated under the direction of a Professor of the University of Chicago, and a military training school. Jan saw much fighting, having been on five fronts, the Russian,Turkish,Hungarian,Italian and Austrian. He tramped Siberia from Kiev to Vladivostock with the Czecho-Slav army, fighting the Bolsheviki and the Hun every inch of the way, and witnessed much suffering in his own land. He was brought to this country by Professor Neal, to whom he was intrusted at baking by Mr.Brashkovsky,the "little grandmother of the Russian revolution". Jan will eventually return to help alleviate the sufferings of his people.
